dog.description_text: Tammy is currently in a foster home with her sister, Tamara. Tammy has the most adorable little face you’ve ever seen. While her sister leads the way, Tammy is perfectly content to follow along, especially if it leads to a sunny windowsill or a session with her favorite toys. She absolutely loves being petted and has a gentle, affectionate nature. While Tammy is often found right by her sister's side and would love to stay with her, she is a lovely, soulful girl who could also thrive on her own in a home that offers plenty of love and playtime. Apply today.
dog.name: Tammy
